description: Take-home pay for an employee in Morocco from a gross yearly salary in MAD, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: IR barème from the 2025 finance law (0-37%); Professional expenses 35% (max 30,000 MAD) up to 78,000 gross, 25% (max 35,000) above; CNSS with its ceiling, AMO, CIMR; Family charges for spouse and children (600 MAD each from 2026); Employer contributions and vocational training tax.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many MAD, for the euro amounts. Default 10.7 (indicative).

gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in MAD, without bonus

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

pension_pct.description: Voluntary employee pension contribution through payroll, % of salary. Default 0.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in MAD, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

name: net_salary
title: Net salary in Morocco (2026)
